description: Every rejection rule in PRD 5.1.3 and 8.3, plus the promotion gates from portfolio-project-selection.md. Generated from packages/contracts/src/rules/registry.ts.

rules.repair: Use an uppercase track prefix and a zero-padded number, e.g. RAG-01. Prefixes come from content/taxonomy/tracks.v1.json.
Lowercase, digits and single hyphens only; no leading, trailing or repeated hyphens. Derive it from the title.
rules.summary: `slug` must match ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

rules.repair: Run the migration script for your record's version before validating. Records are never silently upgraded.
rules.summary: `schemaVersion` must equal the current schema version.

rules.repair: Remove the property, or add it to the schema through a reviewed migration. Manifests cannot carry ad-hoc fields.
rules.summary: Unknown properties are rejected at every object boundary (additionalProperties: false).

rules.repair: Name the system, not the category. Move qualifiers into `tagline` or `summary`.
rules.summary: `title` must be 8-90 characters.

rules.repair: State one hard claim. If you cannot state it yet, omit the field rather than padding it.
rules.summary: `tagline`, when present, must be 20-160 characters.

rules.repair: Describe the problem and the system in two or three clauses. Do not restate the title, and do not paste the case study.
rules.summary: `summary` must be 80-320 characters.

rules.repair: Correct the day or month, e.g. 2026-02-30 does not exist. JSON Schema can check the pattern but not the calendar, so this rule is Zod-only.
rules.summary: A date field has valid ISO shape but is not a real calendar date.

rules.repair: Replace the http:// URL with https://, or mark it as a localhost fixture link.
rules.summary: Remote links must use HTTPS, except explicit localhost fixtures.

rules.repair: Set links.canonical to /projects/ followed by this record's slug. PRD 0.3 makes the dedicated URL mandatory and canonical.
rules.summary: `links.canonical` must be the site-relative path /projects/{slug}.

rules.repair: Add width and height in pixels. PRD 9.3 budgets zero layout shift from project media, which requires reserved geometry.
rules.summary: Every image record must declare intrinsic width and height.

rules.repair: Describe what the image shows, not that it is a screenshot. Empty alt is only valid for decorative media, which a card image is not.
rules.summary: A public project's card and hero images must have non-empty alt text.

rules.repair: State the hardware, load profile, dataset and duration. A number without its environment is not evidence.
rules.summary: Every metric must declare `environment`.

rules.repair: Add the ISO 8601 timestamp of the measurement run.
rules.summary: Every metric must declare `measuredAt`.

rules.repair: Link the raw result file, report, or run log that produced this number.
rules.summary: Every metric must declare `evidenceUrl`.

rules.repair: Set synthetic: true for benchmark and simulated load results, false only for measurements taken against real traffic. Never omit it.
rules.summary: Every metric must declare an explicit boolean `synthetic` status.

rules.repair: Numeric comparison requires compatible units. Use a unit from content/taxonomy/metrics.v1.json whose dimension is accepted by the metric's category.
rules.summary: A metric's `unit` must belong to a dimension compatible with its `category`.

rules.repair: Correct whichever date is wrong. A project cannot finish before it begins.
rules.summary: `dates.completed` cannot precede `dates.started`.

rules.repair: Re-verify the project and update lastVerified, or correct the completed date. Verification happens after completion.
rules.summary: `dates.lastVerified` cannot precede `dates.completed` when completed is present.

rules.repair: Add a metric with environment, measuredAt, evidenceUrl and synthetic status, or lower proofLevel to `live` or `code`.
rules.summary: proofLevel `measured` requires at least one metric carrying evidence.

rules.repair: Link the upstream acceptance, third-party audit, or external publication. Self-published reports are not external validation.
rules.summary: proofLevel `externally-validated` requires at least one evidence item with external: true.

rules.repair: A flagship is a finished, measured system with real media. Until it is, leave featured.global false; intent belongs in the track's flagship rotation, not on the record.
rules.summary: `featured.global: true` requires tier `flagship`, proofLevel `measured` or better, and a non-placeholder card image.

rules.repair: Complete the missing fields, or set visibility to `private` until the work has evidence. Publication is an editorial act, not a default.
rules.summary: A public project must have summary, roles, proofLevel, status, a primary evidence item, image alt text, and a canonical URL.

rules.repair: Link the repository, the running system, or the written case study. A finished project with nothing to inspect cannot be published.
rules.summary: A public `complete` or `maintained` project requires at least one evidence item and at least one source, live, or case-study link.

rules.repair: Write the one hard claim the project supports. The field is optional for planned and private records precisely so it is never fabricated.
rules.summary: A public project must have a `tagline`.

rules.repair: Pick the single strongest artifact as primary. The detail route leads with it; a tie means the ordering is undefined.
rules.summary: At most one evidence item may be marked `primary: true`.

rules.repair: Rename the duplicate. Evidence IDs are anchors for deep links into the detail page.
rules.summary: Evidence `id` values must be unique within a record.

rules.repair: Rename the duplicate so each measurement is addressable.
rules.summary: Metric `id` values must be unique within a record.

rules.repair: Score the project across the six dimensions before promoting it. If it scores below 85 it is a focused exhibit, not a keystone.
rules.summary: A public `keystone` or `flagship` record must carry a selection score of at least 85/100.

rules.repair: Below 70 the project does not earn a public card. Strengthen the evidence or leave it private.
rules.summary: A public `focused-exhibit` or `case-study` record must score at least 70/100.

rules.repair: Recompute: roleRelevance(25) + engineeringDepth(20) + productionEvidence(20) + demoClarity(15) + differentiation(10) + portfolioReuse(10).
rules.summary: `selection.score` must equal the sum of its six dimension scores.

rules.repair: Use an existing vocabulary entry or its alias. Adding a term is a reviewed taxonomy change, not a manifest edit.
rules.summary: Facet values must exist in the versioned vocabulary for their group (languages, frameworks, capabilities, domains, evidence types, metric categories, accent tokens, tracks).

rules.repair: Migrate to the term named in the vocabulary entry's `deprecated.replacedBy`.
rules.summary: A referenced vocabulary term is deprecated.

rules.repair: Either correct the track or renumber the record. RAG-07 cannot belong to the systems track.
rules.summary: A record's `id` prefix must match the ID prefix declared by its `track`.

rules.repair: IDs are permanent and unique. Renumber the newer record.
rules.summary: Duplicate `id` across the catalog.

rules.repair: Slugs are the canonical URL. Disambiguate the newer record's slug.
rules.summary: Duplicate `slug` across the catalog.

rules.repair: Two cards cannot claim the same repository root. Point subprojects at their directory or package path, per the selection document's monorepo topology.
rules.summary: Duplicate canonical repository URL across the catalog.

rules.repair: Each case study belongs to exactly one project record.
rules.summary: Duplicate case-study URL across the catalog.

rules.repair: IDs are permanent after publication. Restore the record, or archive it with status `archived` rather than deleting it.
rules.summary: A published `id` was removed or reassigned.

rules.repair: Add the old slug to the redirect map so existing deep links and search-engine results keep resolving.
rules.summary: A slug changed without a generated redirect from the previous value.

rules.repair: The home page shows five ordered flagships. Two projects cannot hold the same rank.
rules.summary: `featured.rank` must be unique among globally featured projects.

rules.repair: The home page leads with exactly five proofs. Demote the extra record or rotate it out of the pin set.
rules.summary: At most five projects may be globally featured.

rules.repair: Revert the field and re-run the owning generator. CI verifies a clean regeneration diff; hand edits are lost on the next build.
rules.summary: A generated field (contentHash, GitHub enrichment, derived facets, ordinals, media variants, index records) was hand-edited.

rules.repair: Fix the path or generate the missing artifact. Internal links are verified on every build.
rules.summary: An internal link does not resolve to a generated route or evidence artifact.

rules.repair: Confirm the destination still exists. Known anti-bot responses belong on the allowlist rather than being silenced globally.
rules.summary: An external link failed scheduled verification.

rules.repair: Replace it with the real destination, or keep the record private until the destination exists.
rules.summary: A placeholder domain (example.com, example.invalid, localhost) appears in a production build.

rules.repair: A human resolves the conflict. The manifest value is preserved until then - GitHub enriches the catalog, it does not own it.
rules.summary: GitHub and the manifest disagree on a factual field.

rules.repair: Restrict enrichment to the objective field allowlist in PRD 5.1.4. Curated fields are human-owned by definition.
rules.summary: Enrichment attempted to overwrite a curated field (title, summary, role, proof level, metric, display order, visibility).

rules.repair: Fail the production build rather than publishing stale repository facts. Restore API budget or refresh the cache.
rules.summary: Cached enrichment is older than 7 days and the API budget is exhausted.

rules.repair: Wait for the rate-limit reset. Publish from a cache younger than 7 days, or defer the build.
rules.summary: Remaining GitHub API budget fell below 10 percent; enrichment aborted.

rules.repair: Find the nondeterminism: wall-clock timestamps, Math.random, unsorted object keys, locale-sensitive sorting, or platform line endings.
rules.summary: Two builds from identical normalized inputs produced different bytes.

rules.repair: Reduce the payload. PRD 12.2 forbids raising the budget to make the check pass; the effect is removed, not excused.
rules.summary: A generated artifact exceeded its compressed transfer budget.

rules.repair: Profile the stage. Warm incremental builds target 30s, full 1,300-project builds 120s, cold builds 5 minutes.
rules.summary: A build stage exceeded its service-level objective.

title: Validation rule registry v1
